Below is a list of records held in the [Ultimate Fighting Championship](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ultimate_Fighting_Championship "Ultimate Fighting Championship") (UFC).

#### Most bouts - All fighters
[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=List_of_UFC_records&action=edit&section=3 "Edit section: Most bouts - All fighters")]
On December 16, 1994, Royce Gracie became the first fighter to reach 10 fights in the UFC.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_UFC_records#cite_note-1)
On July 7, 2007, Tito Ortiz became the first fighter to reach 20 fights in the UFC.[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_UFC_records#cite_note-2)
On September 8, 2018, Jim Miller became the first fighter to reach 30 fights in the UFC.[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_UFC_records#cite_note-3)
On July 2, 2022, Jim Miller became the first fighter to reach 40 fights in the UFC.[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_UFC_records#cite_note-4)

  * [Conor McGregor](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Conor_McGregor "Conor McGregor") was the first champion to hold two titles simultaneously.
  * [Daniel Cormier](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Daniel_Cormier "Daniel Cormier") was the first champion to have successful title defenses in two different divisions.
  * [Amanda Nunes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amanda_Nunes "Amanda Nunes") was the first champion to successfully defend two titles while holding them simultaneously.
  * [Ilia Topuria](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ilia_Topuria "Ilia Topuria") was the first champion to hold two titles while being undefeated.

## Finances
[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=List_of_UFC_records&action=edit&section=128 "Edit section: Finances")]
_This category only scores pay-per-view buys from[The Ultimate Fighting Championship event held in Denver, CO (1993)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/UFC_1 "UFC 1") to [UFC 235](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/UFC_235 "UFC 235"). The UFC's 2019 contract with [ESPN+](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ESPN+ "ESPN+") mandates a subscription to the over-the-top service which is the exclusive distributor of UFC pay-per-views in the United States in order to purchase the event. UFC and ESPN do not report on pay-per-view buys starting with [UFC 236](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/UFC_236 "UFC 236")._
